features.name: price_range
features.description: The absolute spread between the highest and lowest price, representing the total price movement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct, continuous measure of market volatility, which is highly informative for linear margins.

features.name: log_open_to_high_ratio
features.description: Log-scaled ratio of the upward price movement from the open price, normalized by the open price.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative upward momentum in a smooth, log-compressed scale suitable for linear models.

features.name: open_to_low_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the downward price movement from the open price, normalized by the open price.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative downward momentum, providing a bounded continuous feature for SVM hyperplanes.

features.name: log_volume_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed and roughly max-scaled trading volume to compress extreme outliers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents large volume outliers from dominating the linear SVM margin while preserving the continuous scale of market participation.

features.name: log_trade_count_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed and roughly max-scaled trade count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, bounded representation of market activity frequency.

features.name: volume_per_trade_log
features.description: Log-transformed average volume per trade, indicating the average size of market transactions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the model distinguish between markets driven by many small trades versus a few large trades.

features.name: open_normalized
features.description: Z-score normalized open price using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes the initial price level, which is a fundamental requirement for stable linear SVM convergence.

features.name: relative_open_position
features.description: The position of the open price relative to the high-low range, scaled between 0 and 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded, continuous indicator of where the market opened relative to its extremes.

features.name: log_price_spread_to_open
features.description: Log-scaled ratio of the total price spread relative to the open price.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures relative volatility in a compressed scale, preventing extreme spreads from skewing the linear decision boundary.

features.name: activity_momentum
features.description: Interaction feature combining log volume and price range to capture high-activity, high-volatility states.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to capture the non-linear interaction between volume and volatility through a pre-computed composite.

features.name: liquidity_judgment
features.description: Assesses the overall liquidity and reliability of the market on a continuous scale from 0 (highly illiquid, untrustworthy signals) to 1 (highly liquid, robust signals) based on the volume and trade count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantic weighting factor that can help the SVM margin discount noisy signals from illiquid markets.

features.name: volatility_regime_judgment
features.description: Assesses the volatility regime of the market on a continuous scale from 0 (stable, low volatility) to 1 (chaotic, extreme volatility) based on the spread between high and low relative to the open price.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates raw price movements into a semantic regime score, allowing the linear model to adjust its sensitivity based on market conditions.
